# Data Availability Matrix

**Status:** Pre-PoC assessment. `Owned` = generated by our system once implemented; `External` = candidate documented/tool source, permission/version validation pending; `Conditional` = coverage or semantics uncertain; `Excluded` = not required. No row is a verified installed capability yet.

| Data | Source | Assessment | UI fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project, delivery, stages, cycles | Domain + SQLite | Owned | No state / setup required |
| Events, decisions, timestamps, retry history | Event store + gateway | Owned | Last known / stale |
| Local snapshot, branch, commits, modified files | Git + snapshot hashing | External/Owned | Reconcile required |
| MR, discussion, review comment, pipeline/job status, logs | GitLab API/MCP | External | Unavailable or stale |
| Required approvals and mergeability | GitLab + policies | Conditional | Block readiness until evidence |
| Reviewer completed latest SHA | Reviewer-specific signal | Conditional | Block or explicit authorized confirmation |
| Test counts and individual cases | Structured test runner reports | Conditional | Only known exit/result; count not reported |
| Finding severity, disposition, plan | Structured Finding/agent output | Owned/Conditional | Unclassified, no fake findings |
| Execution IDs, top-level spans, elapsed, exit code | Orchestrator process runner | Owned | Interrupted/unknown if not observed |
| Tool calls, commands, child spans, file reads | Cursor/Codex structured events/hooks | Conditional | Top-level spans only; no inferred inner actions |
| Inputs/outputs, artifacts | Safe structured payloads/files | Conditional | Not captured / redacted |
| Provider, model, effort, skill | Executor configuration + events | Conditional | Configured vs reported distinction |
| Input/output/cache read/write/reasoning token counts | Provider telemetry | Conditional | Not reported; show coverage |
| Real cost, remaining quota, account-wide usage | Provider billing/subscription interface | Conditional | Not reported; no fabricated cost |
| Hidden AI reasoning | Not needed | Excluded | Never display |
| Session continuation and active external sessions | Provider adapter | Conditional | Manual resume; not monitored |
| Human waiting interval | Action timestamps | Owned | Unknown for incomplete interval |
| Active human touch time | Explicit measurement | Conditional | Not measured; never substitute wait time |
| Knowledge versions, evidence and approval | Learning engine | Owned | Candidate / no evidence |
| Chart aggregates and experiments | Normalized records + benchmark | Owned/Conditional | Coverage/sample size, no fake result |
| External IDE/GitLab deep link | Provider-supported URI/reference | Conditional | Copy safe reference |

## Capability detection presentation

Distinguish Supported (documented), Verified available (observed locally), Limited (some capability missing), Not verified, Not supported, and Not reported for individual data. Store check time, integration version, environment and evidence. A connected integration is not proof that all capabilities work. A failed diagnostic must not disable unrelated capabilities; stale checks need revalidation. Do not treat missing telemetry as zero.
